children: Welcome to our seventh year of ScottyCon! We hope you enjoy CMU's one and only (and therefore best) anime and video gaming convention! We'll have a blast of events this year, ranging from panels, masquerade, artist alley, and much more.
We update this site on a rolling basis. Check back in March for our full event schedule! Meanwhile, view the "Info" tab for more details about our event.
Never miss an update on applications, ticket sales, merch preorders, and more!
